nvitk.gui.panels.dicom_tags
===========================

.. py:module:: nvitk.gui.panels.dicom_tags

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   DICOM tag table for the active Napari layer.

-------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.gui.panels.dicom_tags.DicomTagsPanel

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: _nvitk_metadata(layer: Any | None) -> dict[str, Any]

   *layer*'s nvitk metadata dict (the ``nvitk_metadata`` sub-key), or ``{}`` if unavailable.


.. py:function:: dicom_tags_from_metadata(metadata: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]

   Collect DICOM tag entries from nvitk layer metadata.


.. py:function:: layer_has_dicom_tags(layer: Any | None) -> bool

   True if *layer* was loaded from DICOM or carries any DICOM tag metadata.


.. py:function:: _format_tag_value(value: Any) -> str

   Format a DICOM tag *value* for table display: joins sequences (truncated at 32 items) and
   decodes bytes as UTF-8, else falls back to ``str()``.


.. py:class:: DicomTagsPanel(parent: qtpy.QtWidgets.QWidget | None = None)

   Bases: :py:obj:`qtpy.QtWidgets.QWidget`


   Scrollable table of DICOM tags for the selected layer.


   .. py:attribute:: _status


   .. py:attribute:: _table


   .. py:attribute:: _search


   .. py:attribute:: _btn_refresh


   .. py:attribute:: _last_layer
      :type:  Any | None
      :value: None



   .. py:method:: _apply_search_filter(text: str = '') -> None

      Hide table rows whose tag/value don't contain the (case-insensitive) search *text*.



   .. py:method:: _refresh_last_layer() -> None

      Re-render the DICOM tag table for whichever layer was last shown.



   .. py:method:: refresh_from_layer(layer: Any | None) -> None

      Populate the tag table from *layer*'s DICOM metadata, or show a placeholder if *layer* is
      ``None`` or has no DICOM tags.
